values: 一名暴虐的刺客，擅长对付虚弱的敌人。
A cold-blooded killer, lethal against those who dare to show a moment of weakness.
Ha! I've been yearning for this moment!
就像撕开面包一样容易。
As easy as cutting through butter.
Hey, what are you looking at?
Anything new? I'm looking to be entertained.
Thanks, I'm going to hang this on my axe.
Not what I'm looking for, but it's mine now!
If you keep staring, I'll gouge out your eyes!
This tastes weird. I don't like it!
Let's add some holiday fun! Hahaha!
Ha, this is my kind of vibe!
Let's step outside and stir things up!
奈拉小时候很缠人，索尼娅就教她做手工打发时间。到后来，不仅索尼娅的衣服都是奈拉缝的，甚至她还能赚点小钱补贴家用。

Nara was a very clingy child, so Sonja taught her to sew to keep her occupied. However, later, not only did Nara fix all of Sonja's worn clothing, but she even managed to make a little money to supplement the family's income.
奈拉做了很多布娃娃陪伴自己，即使成为亡灵，她也没有忘记如何穿针、引线、再沿着裂口交叉——她像缝布娃娃一样，缝好了自己的伤口。

Nara made a lot of dolls to keep herself company when she was young. Even after she became a Graveborn, she never forgot how to thread a needle or sew a stitch. She's even able to patch herself up like one of her old playthings.
奈拉在生日的时候收到过一个蝴蝶结，她很珍惜，但却不知道落在了哪里，成为亡灵后，她拿布条和骨头又绑了一个。死潮舰队内部的不成文铁律——一定不能碰到奈拉的蝴蝶结。

Nara received a bow for her birthday, which she loved but lost. After becoming a Graveborn, she took a cloth and a bone and tied another one. An unwritten rule within the Dead Tide Fleet is that one must never touch Nara's bow.
奈拉讨厌波妮，波妮也讨厌奈拉，这种情况是从什么时候开始的呢？大概是波妮第一次见到奈拉，就让她叫自己姐姐起。
Nara hates Bonnie, and Bonnie hates her back. When did this all start? It probably began the first time Bonnie met Nara and asked her to call her "sister."
每次找乐子的时候，奈拉总爱给人出选择题，题目大意总是选择背叛就能活下来，这种把戏，她百玩不厌。

Her form of entertainment is testing people and their relationships. Nara likes to give her victims a choice when it comes to life and death. If they choose betrayal, they will live. This is a game she never gets tired of.
很少有人从奈拉的选择题下全身而退，只有一次，她放过了一对姐妹，因为那个姐姐无论发生什么，都坚定地守护在妹妹面前，绝不放手，这让奈拉感觉没意思极了。

Few people escape unscathed while playing Nara's game. Only once did she free a pair of sisters. The older sister would protect her younger sister no matter what happened. Nara said that they were boring and let them go.
漆黑的夜里，经常有磷蝶飞进奈拉的窗口，这种只在夜里出现的生物不知道为何总爱靠近亡灵。奈拉厌恶在夜里带来光亮的一切事物，但不知为何，没有驱赶这些弱小的磷蝶。

Glim butterflies would often fly into Nara's room. These creatures only appear at night and love being near the Graveborn. Nara hates anything bright at night, but for some reason, she doesn't want to chase away these creatures.
成为水鬼帮老大后，经常有下属为了讨好奈拉送来一些可怕的、他们以为亡灵会喜欢的东西，但奈拉对这些都嗤之以鼻。很少有人发现，她依然像这个年纪的人类女孩一样，喜欢精美可爱的小物件。

As the leader of the Water Wights, some followers would give Nara horrifying gifts—things they thought a Graveborn would like—in order to curry her favor. Few have realized that she enjoys cute little objects like other human girls would.
天气好的的时候，海风会卷来陆地上的花香，吹进潮湿阴暗的船舱，没有亡灵会喜欢阳光，但奈拉却在窗边放了个镜子，无聊的时候，看阳光的碎片游移也是一种乐趣。

When the weather is good, the sea breeze will bring the smell of flowers from the coast and blow into her dark cabin. No Graveborn likes the sunlight, but Nara keeps a mirror by the window. She likes to watch the sunshine drift by.
成为亡灵后，奈拉发现自己的身体虽然破烂却异常坚韧。无论受多重的伤，都能很快复原。多好，她再也不用害怕受伤了。

After becoming a Graveborn, Nara discovered that, although her body was torn and ripped, it's extremely tough. No matter how injured she was, she could recover quickly. Now, she no longer has to worry about getting hurt.
索尼娅姐姐，今天晚上我可以和你一起睡吗……
Sonja, can I sleep with you tonight?
嘻嘻，才不给你呢，这是给索尼娅姐姐的！
Haha, I'm not giving it to you! It's for Sonja!
